study.question: Does the large external-sign effect under matched nuisance exclusion depend on the transported auxiliary-derived Q orientation bit, beyond the unoriented transfer line, radius and exact zero support?
study.hypothesis: At the stronger joint model, the transported Q bit interacts with the chosen exclusion subspace. Removing that bit by canonicalizing the inherited nuisance transfer should reduce or reverse its observed preference for external negative sign. This is a training-only surrogate VJP experiment; it does not assert that the original joint BCE derivative has been preserved or that all auxiliary supervision has been removed.

study.proposed_difference: Add orthogonal_assignment=nuisance_line_canonical. Compute T_H with the unmodified incumbent helper, then U_H=canonical(T_H) using the first maximal-absolute flattened coordinate. Evaluate +/-U_H against +/-T_H. At fixed state canonicalization preserves T_H line, Frobenius norm and exact zeros and is invariant to reversing a nonzero T_H; it removes its orientation, not all auxiliary information. No new forward architecture or learned parameter. Every cell also computes both canonical and signed alternatives.
predictions: Before training at identical parameters, every cell has equal predictions, scalar losses, task-private gradients, state_dict keys/shapes/values and forward buffer/RNG updates. New positive/negative canonical transfers are exact negatives apart from signed zeros, and have the same zero mask and Frobenius norm as the retained transfer; their occupied-row mean, K/H exclusion residuals and post-cast residuals need host checks.

Define S_ret=AUC(retained_negative)-AUC(retained_positive), S_can=AUC(removed_negative)-AUC(removed_positive), and primary mechanism interaction I=S_ret-S_can. Previous S_ret=0.0009540112233360487. Predicted I>0 with collapse or reversal of the negative-sign preference after bit removal; no assumption that canonical positive itself must beat the incumbent.

As arithmetic bridges, retained negative and positive should reproduce g3-r0055 AUC0.6689064289769298 and0.6679524177535937 at the same frozen seed, subject to explicit numerical validation. A discrepancy suspends mechanism interpretation rather than being counted as replication.

All cells keep expected32192421 trainable parameters and the same inference computation. Report measured training/allocated time, examples, peak memory and inference throughput/p50/p95; added common backward argmax work may raise training cost.

Report all four task AUC/Logloss and existing history slices with sample/positive/negative counts, without choosing on auxiliary mean or sparse slice wins. Candidate utility versus click-only and original joint reference is secondary and preliminary until authorized paired repetitions.
falsifiers: If the preflight fails line/norm/exact-zero-support or fixed-state forward/private-gradient/state parity, the intended orientation-only intervention has not been established; stop interpretation and retain the charged failure.
If bridges do not recover the parent outcomes under identical frozen conditions, investigate implementation/numerical causes before interpreting canonical cells.

If S_can remains comparable to or exceeds S_ret, or I does not retain its predicted positive direction under authorized paired repetitions and user-cluster uncertainty, the claimed bit-dependence is unsupported. Lack of intervals/repetitions must remain preliminary, never significant from one seed.

If neither canonical variant offers reproducible click-AUC benefit versus the retained incumbent or click-only reference, it is an attribution control without demonstrated performance utility; retain it as a null or negative finding.
Even I>0 cannot establish informative auxiliary labels as the cause: auxiliary radius, overlap and gates remain, and optimization geometry offers alternative explanations.
